name: Erna Cheer
source:
Originally from a prominent family which got bankrupt due to their failure in space research and exploitation. Aiming on going to a space exploitation related school, Erna came to the island and joined the training school to take the training that's connected with space. Though smart and nobody can defeat her in terms of technology, she is an uncooperative person and isn't interested in teamplay.

[Edited from [url=https://dnandre.wordpress.com/2012/05/02/galge-preview-dolphin-divers/]dnandre's review[/url]]
